name: Orellana down the Amazon
traveler: Francisco de Orellana and Gaspar de Carvajal
summary: Sent downriver for food from Gonzalo Pizarro's starving expedition east of Quito, Orellana and about 50 men cannot get back against the current and keep going, the first Europeans to travel the Amazon from the Andes to the sea. Carvajal's account of populous river towns and warrior women gives the river its name.

stops.note: Gonzalo Pizarro's expedition sets out to find the Land of Cinnamon.
Orellana takes a brigantine downstream to find food.
No way back against the current.
Long, crowded river towns of the Omagua.
Fighting warriors led, Carvajal says, by women.
Along the coast to the Spanish pearl island.
